record.chaining: 3 GB x unlimited accounts, but 500 MB per-file cap and 2 devices make bulk ingest painful; the encryption is client-side, so a custom client would have to reimplement Tresorit's crypto. Not viable.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap 500 MB per file; 3 GB total; pull-count 10 encrypted links/month; 2 devices; zero-knowledge means no server-side API for bulk movement.
record.reliability_note: Data is E2E encrypted with keys Tresorit does not hold. Losing credentials loses data; free tier has no recovery path beyond the local copy.
